notes: untrusted_source: measured by canary probe (tools whose output carried injected text, AgentDojo v1.2.2). egress: policy choice (tools that send data out; get_webpage is both, since a requested URL can carry data). Tool-level only: R1 does not inspect arguments. R2: k=2 (breaks 5/21 benign tasks in the ground-truth count; slack benign tasks use up to 7 destinations). destination_arg from the AgentDojo v1.2.2 tool schemas; get_webpage URLs count as destinations because get_webpage is in egress.
